command_normalization: Only executable and corpus directory paths are normalized; argument values and all measured samples are retained. Raw execution receipt is preserved internally.

measurement_context.concurrent_load_status: non-exclusive workstation run; other heavy jobs may have been active
measurement_context.cpu_isolation: affinity and cpuset observations do not establish exclusive CPU ownership
measurement_context.host_load: workstation under concurrent load during capture
measurement_context.production_rerun_requirement: rerun on reserved isolated cores with recorded affinity, governor, frequency, versions, and host-load evidence before publishing performance claims
measurement_context.timing_interpretation: use timing medians as local regression context only, not final throughput claims

scope: Initial default-feature debug-build baseline for public graph parse, verification, text roundtrip and both emitters. Supported corpus only; no release throughput or prior-implementation speedup claim.
